title: One Day, Three Temples: Madurai Meenakshi + Palani Murugan + Rockfort Trichy
description: A jam-packed day trip covering three iconic Tamil Nadu temples: the Meenakshi Amman Temple in Madurai, the Palani Murugan Temple on its hilltop, and the Rockfort Ucchi Pillayar Temple in Trichy. Sharing timings, how I moved between all three in one day, and what to prioritize if you only have a day like I did.
